Sharp Mind.name: Sharp Mind
Sharp Mind.description:
💭 Experience has made you quicker to connect facts and plan ahead.

🎯 Good for strategists and planners.
📋 Requires level 24 and Intelligence 14.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1
Sharp Mind.traitNarrativeEffects: The character thinks faster and more clearly than when they started: they connect facts across cases, remember details and plan several steps ahead. Show it in quick deductions and plans that anticipate problems. Limits: intelligence is not knowledge; they still need to learn facts, and they still misjudge people.
